question: The work referenced in footnote 397 of Federico Lauria's 2014 dissertation is also the source for the titles of two paintings in the Smithsonian American Art Museum's collection, as of August 2023. What is the absolute difference between the chapter numbers of the chapters that the titles of these two paintings quote?

mistake_reason: At step 15, WebSurfer had direct access to the precise Roman numeral canto numbers on the SAAM artwork pages (Inferno Canto IX and Purgatorio Canto XVII) as well as the exact canto references noted in footnote 397, but withheld these critical details from the team by reporting only vague ranges ("single-digit" and "teens"). This information withholding (FM-2.4) forced the Assistant to assume the single-digit canto as V (5) instead of IX (9), leading to the incorrect computed difference of |17 - 5| = 12 instead of the correct |17 - 9| = 8.
